decisions.reason: The assessment-date copy policy is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event; no additional or corrected MODIFY is required.
Changing the assessment-date field format does not alter the required fonts, icons, or reusable design assets in the delivery package.
The assessment-date display refinement does not change the requirement that templates be straightforward to export as PDFs.
The assessment-date field format is independent of the vehicle identifier and its fixed-line or customer-specific presentation.
The assessment-date placeholder policy does not change the content or scannable format of the front-page result drivers.
The source clause governs assessment-date placeholder text and does not necessarily modify the candidate's current internal-header coverage, presentation, or required information.
The assessment-date field refinement does not alter the retained visual direction or cross-variant theme.
The assessment-date field format does not change the score heading, result fields, prominence, spacing, or visibility.
The assessment-date placeholder policy is unrelated to the final-page confidential distribution warning.
The assessment-date formatting decision does not change the required DX-17 header identifier.
Although assessment date remains listed as footer content, the source decision does not change footer presence or content membership; the date-copy rule is already owned by the core-copy requirement.
The assessment-date field format does not change the DX17–DX20 variant set, editability, or score/risk-based selection rule.
